C1.worst_defect: The hero says "Point of sale for Vendure" and "made for shops that sell online with Vendure and also sell in person", but the home page never says who should NOT use it or how it compares with Shopify POS, Square or Lightspeed. There is no maintainer or about line either, so a sceptic cannot tell who stands behind it. The footer's "Built with TallyUI" and the analytics host ph.wcpos.com (connect-a-till) go unexplained.

C2.worst_defect: The live demo shows features that the only released plugin does not have. at-the-till says "Refund at the till (live demo only)… plugin 0.3.0 does not" and "On plugin 0.3.0, Order details has no customer note. On the live demo, type a Customer note". 0.3.0 is the latest release (2026-10-06, six weeks of silence since), and no page gives a version or date for when real stores get either feature. The home 'Live demo or your own store' table has no customer-note row. The changelog also admits a bug it never fixed: "Not in the release notes: in 0.2.0 and 0.3.0 this role has no ReadOrder".

C3.worst_defect: A trap in the quick-start: the plugin's own device-key role "has the step 4 permissions except ReadOrder, so add ReadOrder". A till set up with the bundled role can sell but is refused order history until the user patches the role by hand. Separately, the plugin-setup snippet `runMigrations(config);` never imports or defines `config`.
C3.where: quick-start.txt 'Optional device key'; plugin-setup.desktop.01 migration snippet

C4.worst_defect: The same ReadOrder workaround is repeated across quick-start, connect-a-till (twice) and the changelog instead of being fixed once in the plugin. The changelog's 0.2.0 bullet "Not in the release notes: …" reads like a patch added after the fact.

C5.worst_defect: The 'What it does today' section starts with two boxed cards, then switches to unboxed text blocks, so the grid looks uneven and unfinished next to the polished hero. The 404 page is three buttons in an otherwise empty viewport.

C6.worst_defect: The phone hero's till screenshot is cropped: the category chips are cut off at "Gif" and only two product tiles show, so the product shot proves little at 390 px.

C7.worst_defect: Docs page titles are generic ("Overview | VendurePOS") and every page shares one OG card. Everything else holds up: Lighthouse 98/100/100/100, CLS 0, JSON-LD, llms.txt, sitemap and search all return 200.

overall_worst.defect: The live demo refunds at the till and takes a Customer note, but the only released plugin (0.3.0, 2026-10-06) does neither, and the site gives no version or date for when real stores get them. A sceptic reads this as a demo that oversells what you can actually install.
overall_worst.where: at-the-till.txt 'Refund at the till (live demo only)' and 'On plugin 0.3.0, Order details has no customer note'; home 'Live demo or your own store' table
overall_worst.fix: Add a 'Customer note' row to the home 'Live demo or your own store' table and to Limitations. For both refunds at the till and customer notes, name the plugin version that brings them to real stores, or link a roadmap entry with a target date. Better still, ship them so the demo and the installable plugin match.
